purpose: Official heritage, public-directory, local-plan and planning-search sources for batch 11 candidates. Candidate-specific conclusions remain limited to records directly read back.

sources.coverage: official National Heritage List entry for 1 Bilton Road, Rugby
sources.binding_limit: The statutory listing identifies the protected building and grid reference but does not prove ownership, sale authority, current use, title extent, EPC, rates or planning-consent history.

sources.coverage: public directory entry for Central Park Brewers Fayre at 2 Central Park Drive, Rugby
sources.binding_limit: The directory corroborates trading identity and address only. It does not verify ownership, freehold title, licensed-premises status, the three flats, sale authority or parcel boundary.

sources.coverage: preferred-options evidence for Site 84, land south of Leicester Road, Wolvey, plus later consultation statement on Regulation 19 inclusion
sources.binding_limit: The evidence identifies the site at preferred-options stage, while the later statement says it is not currently proposed for Regulation 19 inclusion. Neither document is planning permission or an adopted allocation for the marketed 68.2-acre holding.

sources.coverage: public planning search and adopted Borough Plan Review 2021-2039 for Nuneaton and Bedworth
sources.binding_limit: The services provide the official planning and policy route, but no Wisteria Way application, title, contract-pack or development conclusion has been read back. The council notes some older documents may not yet be online.
